The structure of Ca2Ho6Nb4O24 (reduced formula CaHo3(NbO6)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 194), with 36 atoms per unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Nb as octahedral, coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ho and Ca each show eight O neighbors; O centers have five geometric neighbors. The Nb-centered octahedra exhibit corner- and edge-sharing contacts, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites.
